ideas.title: Championship ecosystem
ideas.description: Configurable championship seasons, brackets, and prize pools managed from Founder OS — ties Creator Studio events to a full competitive literary ecosystem.

ideas.title: Premium Magazine ecosystem
ideas.description: Curated premium magazine issues with editorial workflow, subscriber gating, and magazine-specific analytics — distinct from serialized chapter publishing.

ideas.title: Interactive branching editor
ideas.description: Visual node-based editor for branching narratives with reader choice paths, merge points, and analytics per branch.

ideas.title: Epistolary chat editor
ideas.description: Chat-style scene editor for epistolary and messaging-format stories. UI scaffold planned; full backend persistence and reader rendering not complete.

ideas.title: Full Debut Season backend
ideas.description: Database entities for seasons, arcs, and debut-season metadata. Demo-only local storage exists in Creator Studio; production stories use flat chapters.

ideas.title: OG meta server-side rendering for share links
ideas.description: Server-rendered Open Graph and Twitter Card meta for chapter share URLs so WhatsApp, Instagram, and X show rich previews without client-side JS.
